Visual design reference
https://anonymous-report-421.github.io/public-website/?lang=en&view=1
Only the leaderboard layout was used as a reference. Its JavaScript bundle,
fonts, brand artwork and experimental results are not redistributed here.
Method identities are displayed as text only. Lucide icons are used only for
interface actions, not method identities. See the included LUCIDE-LICENSE.
